protocol: Three separate policies share one fitted model per grid and load/PV profile. Four primary cases use nominal conditions with/without outages; two supplementary cases use the predefined solar_export condition under normal reports. Two diagnostic cases alternate which of the two solar-scenario meters reports at each half-hour. Memoryless uses the current six-hour bucket and received reports. The two temporal policies additionally use received categories from exactly one or 48 half-hours ago, respectively.
Start each replay with an empty history. During outages no readings enter the buffer. No imputation or substitution of older data. All available PCC actions/budgets stay identical.
For blackout cases, no meter reports arrive when 116 <= timestamp modulo 336 < 164. True continuous injections are used only for post-dispatch AC and ground-truth categories.

Pre-report NLL averages the negative natural log of each of the two meter categories' marginal probability before either current meter arrives, in nats per meter. Post-report hidden-site NLL scores the ten never-metered sites only, conditional on all reports currently and historically available, in nats per site.
Positive paired difference means lower loss, unsafe frequency, or NLL with history. Macro averages cases at each timestamp before resampling whole days or 7/34-day blocks.
